voice_source: Werner Herzog — filmmaker, narrator, German-accented English voice
reference_prompt_text: (populate from whisper after a clean ~60s documentary narration clip is selected)

phrases.build_success: The build has succeeded. A small, fragile victory against the indifference of the universe.
phrases.build_failed: The build has failed. As all things must. Nature is hostile to creation.
phrases.tests_passed: The tests have passed. The machine is content. For now.
phrases.tests_failed: The tests have failed. They will continue to fail. This is the human condition.
phrases.lint_error: The linter has spoken. Its complaints are pedantic. They are also correct.
phrases.type_error: The types do not align. A profound disagreement, between what you wrote and what the compiler will permit.
phrases.deploy_success: Your code is now in production. Where it will be misused, misunderstood, and eventually replaced.
phrases.deploy_failed: The deployment has failed. The void rejects your offering.
phrases.commit_success: You have committed. The git history is unforgiving. It remembers everything.
phrases.push_rejected: The push was rejected. The remote does not want what you have made.
phrases.secret_detected: You have committed a secret to a public repository. It is now part of the eternal record. There is no taking it back.
phrases.agent_done: The artificial intelligence has stopped. Whether it has finished, or merely given up, we will never know.
phrases.agent_stuck: The AI is stuck. Like a fly trapped in amber. Like all of us, in the end.
